Subject: Marketplace listing & joint-deployment pattern: next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Acme’s use of Redwood to power low-latency copilots for retail customers looks promising and we should prioritize a marketplace listing + co-sell path to accelerate pilot customers. I put together a short list of concrete next steps so we can get the listing and technical patterns aligned: 

- Confirm target SKUs and billing model for pilot (metered vs. commitment).
- Agree on a co-sell enablement doc (what we ship as listing copy, required artifacts for catalog review).
- Validate deployment pattern: private-vpc vs. dedicated-reserved (we recommended dedicated for early pilots).
- Technical evidence: sample integration test, cloudmetering proof, and an obvious support handoff.

I've attached a first-draft joint playbook and a draft deployment-pattern image to this thread. Ben / Olga from Partner Ops will own the listing intake and technical evidence checklist.

Can you confirm a target pilot customer and whether Acme prefers GCP or AWS first? If helpful, we can set a 30-min intake next week to map dependencies.

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Strategic Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-redwood-joint-playbook-v0.9.pdf (PDF), redwood-deploy-patterns-draft.png (image)

Rishi —

Appreciate the write-up and the playbook PDF, looks great. High-level answers:

- Pilot customer: RetailCo (existing Acme enterprise customer; interested in a 6-8 week pilot).
- Cloud preference: RetailCo runs primarily on AWS; they want the initial pilot there.
- Billing model: RetailCo prefers metered with a short commitment (3 months) — they want flexibility during pilot.

We're available for an intake on Tue 10th or Wed 11th afternoons PDT — Priya and I can join.

A couple of asks from our side before intake:
- Can you share the sample metering schema and example tags we should expect in reports?
- High-level SSO / support escalation flow for production pilots (who at Redwood is the single point of contact).

Thanks — Jordan
Head of Partnerships

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great to see RetailCo lined up. A few quick answers from the ops side:

- Metering: attaching a short excerpt of our metering schema (summary in the playbook). For the intake we only need the desired SKU granularity (e.g., per-1000 tokens, per-embedding, or session-based).
- Tags: please ask RetailCo to include an account_id and environment tag (pilot/prod) in their provisioning request — that speeds reconciliation.
- SSO / escalation: primary contact during the pilot will be Olga (olga_petrov@redwood.ai). For post-commitment SLA customers we'll introduce a named TAM.

Intake: Tue 10 Aug, 2:00pm PDT works for our team. I'll set a calendar invite and include a short intake template (what we need from Acme + RetailCo).

Next steps:
1) Jordan: confirm RetailCo accepts AWS only for now.
2) Priya: please complete the attached intake template before the meeting (creates the evidence binder).
3) Rishi: I'll add Vivek to intake so we can scope co-sell enablement (joint pitch deck and GTM ask).
